hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; npm run lint > /tmp/claude-lint-output.txt 2>&1; code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then out=$(cat /tmp/claude-lint-output.txt); jq -n --arg out "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: ("Lint failed, commit blocked:\n" + $out)}}'; exit 2; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running npm run lint before commit...
